coordinates.frame: Head frame (SOFA): x = front, y = left ear, z = up; origin at the centre of the head.
coordinates.azimuth: Azimuth in [0, 360): 0 = front, 90 = left, 180 = back, 270 = right (counter-clockwise from above).
coordinates.elevation: Elevation in [-90, 90]: 0 = horizontal plane, +90 = above the head.
coordinates.interaural_polar: Lateral angle = asin(y), positive to the left; polar angle = atan2(z, x): 0 front, 90 above, 180 behind.
coordinates.dataset_native: CIPIC was measured on an interaural-polar grid: 25 lateral angles (-80..80 deg) x 50 polar angles (-45..230.625 deg in 5.625 deg steps) at 1 m. The SOFA release stores the same positions as SOFA spherical azimuth/elevation; SonicSphere reads those and converts them.
coordinates.world_frame: 3D scene: right-handed, +Y up, metres. At yaw 0 the listener faces -Z, so world -X is the listener's left. Yaw is positive to the left (counter-clockwise from above), pitch positive nose-up.
